instruction: Candid documentary photograph, full shot. On an indoor squash court with a wooden floor, the woman in the white athletic dress (R2) stands on the left, facing right, and high-fives the man in the blue t-shirt and black shorts (R1) standing on the right. Both smile as their raised right hands meet. The woman holds her racket pointing down, while the man holds his racket in his left hand. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the court.
elements: R1 is the high-five partner whose right hand meets R2's raised right hand while R1 holds his racket in his left hand
R2 is the high-five partner holding her racket pointing down while her raised right hand meets R1's raised right hand
R1 and R2 are smiling as their raised right hands make contact
R1 holds a racket in his left hand during the high-five
R2 holds a racket pointing down during the high-five
The interaction takes place on an indoor squash court with a wooden floor

questions.q: Is R1 raising a hand to complete a high-five with R2, rather than R1 remaining fully passive with both hands down?
Are R1 and R2 the two people whose hands meet in the high-five, rather than interacting with someone else?
Is R2 also raising a hand toward R1 for the high-five, rather than keeping both hands down?
